title: Ranji Trophy: Maharashtra crush Bengal by 10 wickets at Eden to go top of Group C
dek: Bengal were bowled out for 186 on the final day, leaving a target of 112 that Prithvi Shaw and Sachin Dhas reached in under 20 overs. It is Bengal's first defeat of the season.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Maharashtra beat Bengal by 10 wickets at Eden Gardens on Thursday, the final day of their Ranji Trophy Elite Group C match, handing Bengal their first defeat of the season and taking their place at the top of the group.

Resuming on 76 for 4, one run ahead, Bengal were bowled out for 186 in 54.4 overs, setting Maharashtra 112 to win. Openers Prithvi Shaw (53 not out off 50 balls) and Sachin Dhas (61 not out off 68) knocked them off in 19.4 overs, according to the scorecard published by The Hindu. Maharashtra took seven points, including a bonus point, for their second outright win, moving to 19 points and past Bengal.

Pradeep Dadhe took 4 for 48 and left-arm spinner Hitesh Walunj 4 for 53 in Bengal's second innings. Abhishek Porel made 65 and Sumanta Gupta 59 in a stand of 64 for the seventh wicket, after Suraj Jaiswal and Shahbaz Ahmed fell leg before to Dadhe early in the day. Once Walunj removed Porel, caught at slip off his glove, the last three wickets fell for 35 runs.

Rain and bad light had cut into play on three days. Maharashtra made 218 in their first innings in reply to Bengal's 143, with Tanay Sanghavi unbeaten on 60 and Mohammed Shami taking 4 for 37.
